entries.53576868657b2341: This business manufactures and sells machinery products, such as machine tools for production equipment, and cast products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥14,400 million (up 11.7% year on year). In the Machine Tools division, orders from the shipbuilding and energy industries in Japan remained firm, and demand in the aircraft industry, its core market, recovered and orders increased; sales also rose with sales of large machines to the die and mold industry. In the Automatic Machinery division, revenue increased as large projects were recorded as sales.
entries.5c3e1b309f9df7a1: Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,350,879 million, up 18.8% year on year. In the IT Infrastructure Distribution Business, it is also strengthening its recurring business, centered on cloud products offered through the subscription management portal 'iKAZUCHI (thunder)'.

entries.8f29c5f9cb3eb397: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥32,030 million, up 29.4% year on year. In the IT Infrastructure Distribution Business, the company is working to strengthen combined proposals that pair networking and software with PCs and servers, as well as its recurring business.
entries.96bd69728c3d3ae6: This business sells computer and peripheral equipment such as PCs and servers, and handles everything from logistics, introduction support and maintenance, and system construction to cloud services. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,336,479 million (up 18.9% year on year), accounting for most of the reportable segment revenue within consolidated revenue of ¥1,350,879 million. Client PCs drove performance strongly, as the company won many replacement-demand orders ahead of the end of Windows10 support in October 2025. In education, many joint procurement projects for the second phase of the GIGA School program were won, resulting in a significant increase in revenue; for government agencies, projects from local public entities were won and revenue increased. PC sales for individual customers were also strong through both mass retailers and EC channels. Server products exceeded the prior year through combined proposals of PCs, cloud, networks and software, although there was a decline from the prior year's large projects. Centered on cloud products offered through the subscription management portal 'iKAZUCHI (Thunder)', it is also strengthening its recurring-billing business. It is stated that from the fourth quarter onward, global demand for semiconductors rose mainly for AI-related data centers, causing price increases for PCs and servers and delivery schedule adjustments in some projects.

entries.ed8013dcbddfbea3: The company positions the period of its medium-term management plan (fiscal years ended March 2025 to March 2027) as a “growth period driven by business portfolio transformation,” and lists “growth under the holding company structure,” “challenge for record highs,” and “enhancing stakeholder engagement” as its basic group policies. In the IT Infrastructure Distribution Business, the company says it is shifting its sales focus from PC hardware alone to combined proposals that include networking, security and software, and will deepen its presence in growth areas such as AI and cloud. In the Industrial Machinery Business, the company says it will strengthen service sales, such as overhauls and maintenance of machine tools, and advance development of high-precision vertical lathes for the aircraft and energy industries. Its medium- to long-term vision, “2030 VISION,” calls for becoming an “All-in-One Solution Company” that “connects” the entire IT market, with distribution as its unchanging core.
